language.label: Language
signin.title: Sign in
signin.lead: Sikkerheit is for company staff. Sign in with your work account.
signin.failed.mfa_required: Sign-in requires multi-factor authentication (MFA). Sign in again with MFA.
signin.failed.no_role: Your account has no Sikkerheit role. Contact an administrator.
signin.failed.expired: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
error.title: Something went wrong
orgs.title: Customers
orgs.name: Name
connection.title: Microsoft 365 connection
connection.entraP1Help: Without Entra ID P1, MFA enforcement is assessed through Security Defaults or per-user MFA.
connection.consentInstructions: Send the link to a global administrator of the customer. After consent, press “Verify connection”.
connection.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Microsoft 365? Collection stops. The customer's administrator must remove the application from their tenant.
connection.modules: Data sources in the last collection
connection.notConnectedLead: The customer is not connected to Microsoft 365 yet.
runs.title: Collections
findings.title: Issues
findings.subject: Applies to
finding.decisionHelp: Administrators only. The decision holds until the review date, at most one year.
finding.staleWarning: The result is stale: no fresh collection within the freshness window.
assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.evidenceExpired: Details deleted after the retention period
reason.missing_observation: No data from the last collection
reason.applicability_input_missing: Missing data to decide whether the check applies
reason.release_catalog_stale: The Windows release catalog is out of date
reason.build_not_in_catalog: The Windows build is not in the catalog
reports.title: Weekly reports
reports.lead: The report is created automatically on Monday at 06:00 for the previous week. The technician sends it to the customer.
policy.title: Policy
policy.excludedUsers: Excluded users (object ID, one per line)
policy.excludedUsersHelp: Emergency access and service accounts. Applies to M365-001 and M365-007, not to administrators.
policy.phoneAccepted: Phone (SMS/voice) counts as an MFA method
policy.deviceAlternative: Accept “MFA or compliant device” as MFA enforcement
policy.trustedLocations: Accept an exclusion for trusted locations
policy.windowsNote: WIN-011 is required. Server checks are computed automatically. Provider names and identifiers: one per line.
policy.saved: Policy version {version} was saved. Assessments are recalculated.
policy.readOnly: Only administrators can change the policy.
settings.lifecycleLead: Disabling stops collection. Deletion requires an export after disabling and happens 30 days after it is scheduled.
settings.exportLead: An archive with all data and reports of the customer. The file is available for 7 days.
staff.title: Staff
staff.lead: Roles are assigned in Entra ID by the company's administrator.
staff.name: Name
problem.idempotency_conflict: The request was already sent with other values.
problem.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.temporarily_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
problem.session_required: The session has expired. Sign in again.
problem.csrf_failed: The session has expired. Reload the page.
problem.forbidden: You do not have access to this action.
problem.workflow_transition_forbidden: This change is not allowed in the current state.
problem.lifecycle_transition_forbidden: This change is not allowed for the customer's status.
problem.connection_state_conflict: The connection is in the wrong state for this action.
problem.tenant_conflict: This tenant is already connected to another customer.
problem.consent_not_granted: Consent has not been granted yet, or the application lacks permissions.
problem.resource_not_ready: The file is not ready yet.
problem.unsupported_schema_version: The agent sends an unsupported format.
problem.unexpected_subject: The batch contains an unknown subject.
problem.agent_version_unsupported: The agent version is no longer supported.
problem.identity_conflict: The device conflicts with another enrollment.
problem.challenge_invalid: The challenge is invalid or expired.
consent.successText: Thank you! Sikkerheit now has read-only access to Microsoft 365. The technician verifies the connection and lets you know when the first check is done. You can close this window.
consent.failedText: No access was granted. Contact the technician if you meant to give consent.
devices.title: Windows devices
devices.lead: PCs with the Sikkerheit agent. The agent registers itself with the enrollment key and sends data to the service.
devices.empty: No devices yet. Register the agent on a PC with an enrollment key.
devices.name: Name
devices.conflictHelp: Check the PC before you decide (RB-11). A clone is removed and installed again; the original device is not revoked.
devices.scanLead: Ask the agent for a new full scan, for example to verify a fixed problem. The request is valid for 24 hours.
devices.scanRequested: The request is delivered at the next check-in and is valid until {time}.
devices.revokeLead: The device may no longer send data, and the installation cannot be registered again. Its problems are closed. This cannot be undone; a new registration needs a new installation.
conflictKind.fingerprint: The machine identity does not match (a clone or a new motherboard).
conflictKind.key: A new device key without a signature of the old one (a clone or a cleared TPM).
keys.title: Enrollment keys
keys.lead: The key is distributed to the PCs through the RMM and is used for registration only. Two keys can be active so that a key can be replaced without a gap. Registered agents keep working after the key is revoked.
keys.label: Name
keys.limit: Two keys are already active. Revoke one of them before you create a new one.
keys.secretLead: The key is shown only now. Copy it to the secret variable of the RMM; it cannot be shown again.
keys.revokeLead: The key “{label}” can no longer be used for registration. Registered agents are not affected.
releases.title: Windows releases
releases.lead: The catalog of monthly Windows updates that SYS-003 compares the PCs with. It applies to all customers. A month counts only after an administrator has verified it.
releases.manageLead: Import the month as a draft, compare it with the Windows release information page and verify it (RB-13) within 7 days of Patch Tuesday.
releases.entriesHelp: One per line: build ubr kb kind securityMonth date [auto|manual]. Example: 26200 9711 5062002 security_monthly 2026-10 2026-10-13. Use - for a release without security fixes.
releases.verifyLead: Verification puts the drafts into effect and recalculates the assessments of the PCs. A month without new releases is verified with the box below.
releases.noNew: The month has no new releases
check.WIN-001: Free space on the system volume
policy.invalidList: Check the identifiers, duplicates and list limit.
policy.param.expectedTenantId: Expected Entra tenant ID (blank: no requirement)
devices.loadBeforeRevoke: Load all pages before revoking devices for a key.
devices.bulkLead: Revoke these {count} active devices permanently? Their installations cannot register again. Revoke the leaked enrollment key separately.
policy.noChanges: There are no policy changes to save.
policy.reviewHelp: Check the changes below. Applying them creates a new policy version and recalculates current results.
bulk.title: Bulk work assignment
bulk.selected: Selected: {count} (maximum {limit}). Only selected findings are changed.
bulk.reviewHelp: Review each finding. Changes use its current revision; conflicts are reported separately.
bulk.noChanges: The selected findings already have these values.
bulk.resultHelp: Review the results. An unknown result may already have been applied: refresh before trying again. Remaining items are not attempted after a connection or access failure.
views.title: Finding views
views.name: View name
views.localHelp: Only the name and filters are saved for your account in this browser (up to eight views).
views.storageError: This browser could not save the view.
views.workHelp: Active clients and subjects; open tasks in New or In progress. These filters can be combined.
templates.title: Policy templates
templates.help: Fill a draft with a preset, then review and save a new version. Customer exclusions, tenant ID, provider lists, account exceptions and schedules are kept.
templates.reviewHelp: These changes only fill the draft. Review and save the policy to create a new version.
templates.draftApplied: Template applied to the draft. Review the settings below, then save a new policy version.
templates.m365-baseline.name: Microsoft 365 — baseline
templates.m365-baseline.help: Activate M365-001–006 with default assessment modes, freshness and thresholds. Keep role and consent allowlists. M365-007 stays unchanged.
templates.m365-stronger-mfa.name: Microsoft 365 — MFA without phone methods
templates.m365-stronger-mfa.help: The Microsoft 365 baseline, excluding phone methods from accepted MFA registration. Changes assessments, not Microsoft 365 settings.
templates.windows-baseline.name: Windows — baseline
templates.windows-baseline.help: Activate WIN-001–009 and WIN-011 with default modes and thresholds. Keep trusted providers and account/edition exceptions. Tenant binding, server checks and agent schedules stay unchanged.
library.title: Shared policy templates
library.intro: Reusable settings for all technicians. Review changes for each customer before applying.
library.name: Template name
library.portableHelp: Templates keep check modes, freshness and portable thresholds. Customer identities, exclusions, schedules, trusted providers, consent/role lists and edition exceptions are always preserved at the customer.
library.source: Copy portable settings from a customer
library.libraryOnly: This saves the shared template only. Customer policies change only after a separate preview and application.
library.bulkHelp: Select up to 50 active customers, review every change, then confirm. Each customer is saved separately; conflicts require a fresh preview. Unchanged policies are skipped.
library.expired: Preview expired. Review again before applying remaining changes.
library.unknownHelp: The server may have saved this policy. Confirm using the same request before reviewing remaining customers. The repeated request cannot create another revision.
library.finished: Processing finished. Check each result; review again for customers that were not applied.
library.saved: Template version saved. Customer policies have not changed.
library.readOnly: You can read shared templates and their history. An Admin can edit and apply them.
library.archivedHelp: Archived templates stay in history and cannot be applied. Edit to restore this template.
library.chooseHelp: Choose a template, or create one with defaults or an existing customer policy.
